entries.name: Context7
entries.purpose: Up-to-date, version-specific documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks, fetched on demand

install.claude-code: claude mcp add --transport http context7 https://mcp.context7.com/mcp

entries.auth: Optional free API key for higher rate limits, sent as the header "Authorization: Bearer <key>" (local: --api-key). Never write the key in a committed file: use an environment variable.
entries.permissions: Network: sends library names and documentation queries to context7.com. No file or shell access.
entries.why: The user's own pick (SPEC-0011 AC-1c, SPEC-0012 R-6). The skill checks official docs first; Context7 serves them for the exact library version, which cuts answers based on outdated APIs.

entries.name: Playwright MCP
entries.purpose: Drive a real browser from the agent: navigate, fill forms, take screenshots, test and debug web apps

tasks: reproduce a bug in the browser

entries.permissions: Runs a local browser that can open any URL, read pages and fill forms; network access through the browser.
entries.why: Vendor-maintained by Microsoft, Apache-2.0, active. The standard way for an agent to test a UI in a real browser.

entries.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
entries.purpose: Performance traces, network, console and debugging of Chrome from the agent

install.claude-code: claude mcp add chrome-devtools -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@1.11.0 --no-usage-statistics

entries.permissions: Runs a local Chrome that can open any URL and read its pages, network and console. Usage statistics are switched off in the install command.
entries.why: Vendor-maintained by the Chrome DevTools team (Google), Apache-2.0, active. Measures performance where a script cannot.

entries.name: GitHub MCP
entries.purpose: Issues, pull requests, Actions and code search on GitHub from the agent
entries.auth: A GitHub personal access token in the environment variable GITHUB_PAT. The single quotes keep ${GITHUB_PAT} literal, so .mcp.json stores the variable name and Claude Code expands it at run time; the token is never written to a file.
entries.permissions: Reads and writes on GitHub with the permissions of the token: give it the narrowest fine-grained token that does the job.
entries.why: Vendor-maintained by GitHub, MIT, active. Optional: senior-mindset already works through the gh CLI.

entries.name: Cloudflare Docs MCP
entries.purpose: Official, current Cloudflare documentation on demand

install.claude-code: claude mcp add --transport http cloudflare-docs https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp

entries.permissions: Network: sends documentation queries to Cloudflare. Reads public documentation only; no account access.
entries.why: Vendor-maintained by Cloudflare, Apache-2.0, active. Official docs first, for senior-mindset's default platform.

rejected.name: Sentry MCP
rejected.reason: Licence not declared: the server moved to getsentry/toolkit, which GitHub reports as NOASSERTION. Revisit if Sentry clarifies it.
